content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a misunderstanding of the `sg_copy_to_buffer` and `sg_copy_from_buffer` functions. The original implementation incorrectly used `sg_copy_to_buffer` where it should have used `sg_copy_from_buffer`, leading to a logic error when copying data between scatter-gather (SG) lists and linear buffers. This resulted in incorrect data being read from or written to memory, as the direction of the data transfer was reversed.
